nav.localTrustHint: Your notes are stored only in this browser — never sent to a server

notes.title: Notes
notes.selectOrCreate: Select a note or create a new one
notes.selectOrCreateHint: Your memories stay on this device. Pick one from the list or start writing.
notes.noNotesYetHint: Capture your first memory — it saves locally as you write.

tags.title: Tags
tags.deleteTagConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? This removes the tag from all notes.

calendar.noNoteActivity: No note activity for this period.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Your data lives entirely in this browser. Export regularly to keep backups.
settings.privacyBody: Notes, tags, and search indexes are stored on this device using browser storage. Nothing is uploaded unless you export it yourself.
settings.installed: App is installed on this device.
settings.iosHint: Tap the Share button in Safari, then choose "Add to Home Screen".
settings.importConfirm: Importing will overwrite your current local database. Continue?
settings.enableSubBrainsDescription: Organize notes into hierarchical sub-brains. When off, all notes appear in one flat list. Your division data is never deleted.
settings.disableSubBrainsConfirm1: Turn off sub-brains? Navigation, checkboxes, and breadcrumbs will be hidden. All notes will appear as a single flat brain. Your division data stays in the database — nothing is deleted.
settings.disableSubBrainsConfirm2: Confirm again: sub-brain UI will be hidden and notes will show in one list. Division data is preserved and will return if you re-enable this feature.

divisions.title: Sub-brains
divisions.showInactiveHint: Inactive sub-brains are hidden from the tree unless this is enabled.
divisions.rootNameLocked: The main brain name cannot be changed.
divisions.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? This only works when the sub-brain is empty.
divisions.deleteBlockedChildren: Cannot delete: this sub-brain has child divisions.
divisions.deleteBlockedNotes: Cannot delete: this sub-brain still has notes.
divisions.deleteBlockedTags: Cannot delete: this sub-brain still has tags.
divisions.inclusionHelp: Check sub-brains to include their notes. Focus sets where new notes are created.
divisions.noInclusionHint: Select sub-brains above to include their notes in this view.
divisions.moveWarningExcluded: The target sub-brain is not currently included in your view.
divisions.moveMigrateTagsHint: Tags are kept — matching names are linked or recreated in the target sub-brain.
